hooks.command: F=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh 2>/dev/null; nvm use 20 --silent 2>/dev/null; [ -n "$F" ] && pnpm exec prettier --write "$F" --ignore-unknown 2>/dev/null || true

F=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh 2>/dev/null; nvm use 20 --silent 2>/dev/null; [ -z "$F" ] && exit 0; REL="${F#$PWD/}"; PKG_DIR=$(echo "$REL" | grep -oE '^(apps|packages)/[^/]+' 2>/dev/null || true); [ -z "$PKG_DIR" ] && exit 0; PKG=$(jq -r '.name' "$PKG_DIR/package.json" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$PKG" ] && exit 0; pnpm --filter "$PKG" typecheck 2>/dev/null || true

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh 2>/dev/null; nvm use 20 --silent 2>/dev/null; pnpm lint > /tmp/fsd-lint.log 2>&1; EXIT=$?; if [ $EXIT -ne 0 ]; then cat /tmp/fsd-lint.log; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Lint 실패 — 에러 수정 후 다시 커밋하세요. 로그: /tmp/fsd-lint.log"}}'; fi
